# Hitelecom

> Focused on outdoor and industrial 4G and NB-IoT sensing terminals, Hitelecom designs and manufactures field-ready devices for environmental, equipment, structural, water, and asset monitoring.

Hitelecom offers more than 50 industrial IoT sensor terminal configurations. Selected products support 4G, NB-IoT, and LoRa connectivity. Private deployments can use LoRa or LoRaWAN gateways, while cellular terminals can connect directly to Hitelecom Cloud, a customer platform, or an existing application via APIs or MQTT.

Temperature and humidity data loggers in the current portfolio use NFC for configuration and USB for local export; they do not provide cellular uplink unless a specific model states otherwise.

## Product Lines

- [Industrial IoT Products](https://www.hitelecom.com/product): Industrial temperature sensors, temperature and humidity sensors, temperature and humidity data loggers, air quality sensors, TVOC sensors, pressure sensors, soil sensors, tilt sensors, vibration sensors, radar distance and level sensors, asset tracking sensors, and custom gas sensors.

## Connectivity and Platforms

- 4G and NB-IoT for direct cellular connection to Hitelecom Cloud or customer platforms
- LoRa and LoRaWAN for private gateway-based deployments
- API, MQTT, and configurable data models
- Hitelecom Cloud, customer platforms, or privately deployed infrastructure
- Mobile applications for monitoring, alerts, and remote access

## Primary Applications

- Industrial monitoring and smart factories
- Smart water and remote level monitoring
- Smart cities and structural health monitoring
- Smart agriculture and soil monitoring

## Additional Applications

- Smart warehousing and rack safety
- Cultural heritage monitoring
- Cold chain and healthcare
- Transportation and asset tracking
- Smart sanitation and bin fill-level monitoring

## Hardware and OEM/ODM

Hitelecom supports sensing, wireless connectivity, power design, firmware, enclosure engineering, mounting, branding, environmental protection, and production. IP68 and IP69K protection are configuration-dependent and must be validated on the final product.
